title: Launcher Intent Resolution and Task Launch Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies launcher intent resolution and task launch?
options: Separate intent resolution, task policy, process availability, app scheduling, and display presentation, then verify each with matching evidence.
questions.answer: Separate intent resolution, task policy, process availability, app scheduling, and display presentation, then verify each with matching evidence.
questions.explanation: This answer keeps the ownership boundaries distinct and requires version-matched evidence, failure testing, compatibility, and operational follow-through.

questions.prompt: Resolving the launcher activity means its process must already be running.
questions.explanation: Interpreting am start -W total time as only application code ignores intent resolution, process creation, Binder scheduling, window, and system transition work.

questions.prompt: Why is intent resolution distinct from activity execution?
questions.answer: Resolution selects an eligible component; task, process, scheduling, lifecycle, window, and rendering work still follow.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the mechanism and owner that make the explanation causal rather than a memorised sequence.
